Every colour swatch keeps its own colour, the Click'n'Load buttons are the same size, and a submission made from a window the site opened is no longer invisible.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **A mixed colour was destroyed by choosing another swatch.** The whole custom-colour state was one string: which slot was chosen came from nearest-preset arithmetic, and what a slot had been mixed to was never stored at all. The row could hold exactly one hand-mixed colour, painted over whichever preset it sat nearest, and pressing any other circle overwrote it out of existence. Each of the eight now remembers what it was mixed to, and *which* one is chosen is stored as its own fact rather than worked out from the colour. Measured: eight swatches all mixed to the same red, and exactly one of them is still marked as chosen. That was impossible before, because a distance test can only ever mark one of two identical colours.
- **The circle being edited did not change while you dragged.** The palette row updated live and the accent row did not, so a drag looked like it was doing nothing to the swatch it was aimed at.
- **The Click'n'Load countdown buttons were different sizes.** Only "Send now" had a flex rule; "Cancel" kept `width: 100%` from the base button rule as its flex basis, the pair overflowed the 420px window, and the algorithm froze "Send now" at the width of its longest word, so the label wrapped onto two lines and spilled out of the 36px box. Both buttons now share the row evenly, no label wraps, and it was measured with the longest of the 42 translations rather than the shortest: 206px and 206px, both 36px tall.
- **A Click'n'Load submission from a window the site opened went straight past the extension.** The interceptor patches the page's own `fetch`, `XMLHttpRequest` and forms, but a site that opens a helper window and submits from *inside* it is in a different realm with its own untouched copies of all three. The request then left the browser for real, and a JDownloader listening on the port answered it and raised its own window. Measured side by side in a browser: before, the request left and nothing was caught; after, it is caught with its fields intact and the page gets the same `success` it always got. Two smaller gaps closed in the same pass: a `<script src>` aimed at the port, and a plain link to it.

## ✨ Added

- **The report button carries a glyph**, and every button on the options page now has room between its mark and its word rather than only the link-shaped ones.
- **Every entry in the right-click menu has a glyph.** Four rows had none, and more to the point the ones that did were a mix of two weights: nine icons were being drawn as stroked outlines, against a house rule that every glyph is a filled shape. Seven are redrawn solid and moved into the shared icon set, and two were second drawings of icons that already existed and are simply gone.

## 🔤 Changed

- **The big "KnightLoader" heading is gone from the options page.** The tab is already called that, and every card names itself.
- **The About card's first line**, in all 42 languages, now sits next to the repository's own claim and intro.

## 📋 Where things are

- Colours: **Extension options › Colours**. Press a chosen swatch a second time to mix it.
- The report: **Extension options › Problems?**
